2024_general.fact: County site dallascountyvotes.org returns an empty HTTP 202 to every request (bot protection); 2024 not listed in Clarity elections.json and no 2024 Clarity link found. Search shows 2024 summary PDFs (e.g. Upload-6.pdf) on the blocked host. Wayback index for Dallas has no 2024 election-night captures.

2026_primary.fact: EIDs 126006 (Democratic) and 126007 (Republican) taken from the county ENR page as archived by Wayback 2026-03-03 19:59:54 CST (links results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Dallas/126006/ and /126007/); detail.xml shows Region Dallas, ElectionDate 3/3/2026. 126006: 3 distinct night releases with Election Day precinct votes (v368455 8:53:29 PM CST, Dem US Senator Election Day <Precinct name="1004D" votes="1" />; v368563; v368581 2:05:26 AM). 126007: 4 distinct night releases (v368531 10:48:56 PM CST ... v368568). Note 126007 v368380 (6:42 PM CST, before polls closed) already shows Election Day cells.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EID 126270 (listed in elections.json): 6 distinct election-night releases with Election Day precinct votes, first v372964 (5/26/2026 8:16:44 PM CDT, US Senator Election Day <Precinct name="1143R" votes="1" />), then v372993 (8:50:24 PM, 138 precincts) through v373072 (1:14:39 AM).

rationale: Primary and runoff settled by check 1 as LIVE; 2024 undetermined (county site blocked, no Clarity ID, no wayback capture). Two LIVE results give LIVE_PRECINCT.
